datasets.title: Rwanda Current Situation FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic Data for 2021
datasets.description: Rwanda Current Situation FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic data for 2021. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/rwanda_current_situation_fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2021]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys across Rwanda in 2021 to assess acute food insecurity conditions and classify areas into IPC phases. Survey results were spatially coded and compiled into monthly geographic datasets representing the current food security situation.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerator surveys to classify acute food insecurity severity across geographic areas
